findings.problem: Foreign mobile-plan outreach entered food product matching; mocked baseline added a product not ordered
findings.fix: Detect explicit unrelated commercial outreach before catalog, models, pending choices, contact, checkout

findings.problem: Repeated fallback and phone invitations fueled a bot-to-bot loop
findings.fix: One neutral notice per day; related followups suppressed for one hour after latest pitch

findings.problem: Risk that a campaign confirmation acts on a customer pending order
findings.fix: Active-context short yes/numeric/confirmation replies cannot modify or confirm cart

limits: Recognizes explicit mobile-service sales and related followups, not all unsolicited messages or AI senders
Replay uses ordered text without the original elapsed timestamps; TTL has separate clock-controlled test
No permanent blacklist; menu or explicit purchase request resumes normal routing
No inference, Meta or external orders used
Independent synthetic-catalog issue remains: Quiero pedir un Bowl De Garbanzos is ignored even with no campaign; direct Un Bowl De Garbanzos works. Not fixed by this batch.
